name: Whitehurst Custom Woodworking
old_description: Whitehurst Custom Woodworking specializes in handcrafted, heirloom quality furniture. Timeless designs, focus on function and an emphasis on natural materials and proper joinery techniques are used to craft each piece. Love your space with irresistible furniture that works for your lifestyle.
about:
Whitehurst Custom Woodworking operates from Raleigh, North Carolina. The business was founded by Jeremy, who grew up in Tarboro, NC, watching his father work with metal. After purchasing his first home in college, he began building small pieces and eventually turned his woodworking passion into a full-time career after more than a decade and two other careers.

The shop produces handcrafted, heirloom-quality furniture with an emphasis on timeless design, function, natural materials, and traditional joinery techniques. Its core offerings include custom furniture pieces and end-grain butcher blocks. The company serves the Raleigh, Durham, and Chapel Hill areas, though it ships beyond the region.

Customers are primarily residential clients seeking custom furniture for their homes. Testimonials reference a cherry wood dining table, a sewing station, and other personalized pieces, illustrating a focus on one-off commissions rather than volume production.

Jeremy states his mission is to preserve the craft of fine furniture making by offering the community furniture built with exceptional craftsmanship rooted in tradition while embracing innovation. The company's tagline, “How it’s made matters,” underscores its commitment to process and material integrity.
